protocol.scope: Two exposed development cases; a mechanism screen, not superiority or fresh confirmation
protocol.case_selection: First two official records, reused from verified source-parity artifacts
protocol.model_execution: FP16 base, BF16 occurrence deltas, greedy max40 generation, sequential merge
protocol.gradient: Per-target-token actual down-column CE gradients, all sequence positions, loss scale128; float64 CPU Gram scoring; last3 layers excluded
protocol.selector: min_prompt dot(gradient_prompt, mean_gradient) / norm(mean_gradient); top5 per target token
conditions: single-prompt gradient supports + same three-prompt training
consensus layer/occurrence-multiplicity matched random + same training
protocol.fit: Adam lr.001, max50 steps, max token/prompt NLL + mean prefix KL + mean repetition + .1 global delta norm; alpha1 beta10; stop maxNLL < -log(.9)
protocol.budget: Same number of independent 4096-wide occurrence deltas as FiNE for all new fits; discovery compute charged separately
protocol.advance_criterion: Consensus must retain both original edit prefixes, gain at least2 of6 held-out-wording prefixes over BOTH FiNE+augmentation and single-gradient+augmentation, and lose no additional baseline-correct utility prefixes versus either; require at least8/32 utility baseline matches. A pass only advances to fresh cases and strong low-rank comparisons.
protocol.failure: Report all settings; no rate/prompt/support tuning on the pilot. Lack of gain over augmented FiNE does not establish a better selector. Prefix matches are not complete-answer correctness.
protocol.limitations: Two exposed facts; assistant-authored wordings and utility gold; no independent human labels; no strong LoRA comparator in this initial selector screen; no novel-method claim
